evidence.reason: `complete()` records `rollback.permitted` as `True` unconditionally. The queue compatibility that governs rollback can change during the health window, and `complete()` does not re-read it; `rollback_to_prior()` later re-checks compatibility and can refuse, so the completed record can falsely claim rollback is permitted. Deriving the recorded value from `compatibility_record()`/`rollback_compatible()` makes the record match the same rule already used for enforcement and does not change rollback behavior.
